## Questions

*Five questions, the first open. Question 2 is a kit surface. These are the only clinical claims on this page.*

- `faq.label` — Frequently asked questions
- `faq.heading` — Quiet questions. Honest answers.
- `faq.note` — Practical notes — not medical advice.
- `faq.items.1.q` — How often should I empty or change my ostomy pouch?
- `faq.items.1.a` — Empty drainable pouches at around one-third to one-half full. Full system changes are often every few days, or sooner if you feel burning, itching, or a leak. Your NSWOC can help you find a wear time that suits your body — wear time varies a great deal between people and is not something to judge yourself against.
- `faq.items.2.q` — Can I customize an ostomy kit? *(kit surface — renders nowhere today)*
- `faq.items.2.a` — Yes. Start from a curated kit, adjust the quantities, add anything that was missing, and save your version — or subscribe so the restock keeps arriving on your own schedule. *(kit surface — renders nowhere today)*
- `faq.items.3.q` — How do ostomy supply subscriptions work?
- `faq.items.3.a` — On a product page, choose Subscribe & save, pick a frequency that matches your wear time, then check out like any order. Skip a delivery when you still have extras — no charge, nothing ships. Manage pause, skip, or cancel under Account → Subscriptions.
- `faq.items.4.q` — What belongs in an ostomy go-bag?
- `faq.items.4.a` — A spare barrier and pouch, soft wipes, disposal bags, and any skin protectant or adhesive remover you use — plus spare underwear or a liner if that helps you feel ready to be out.
- `faq.items.5.q` — What can I ask a pharmacist about my ostomy?
- `faq.items.5.a` — Everyday product and restock questions, in Ontario during business hours until 5 p.m. Eastern. Clinical concerns — fit, skin, and anything about the stoma itself — belong with your NSWOC or surgeon rather than a pharmacist.
